auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Team access only
auth.setupIntro: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password…), then enter the 6-digit code.
auth.recoveryIntro: Each code allows one sign-in if you lose your phone. Store them safely: they will not be shown again.
auth.recoverySaved: I have saved my recovery codes
auth.verifyIntro: Enter the code shown by your authenticator app.

home.title: Hello, {{name}}
home.intro: Order management arrives in the next phases. Press Ctrl+K to navigate quickly.

users.title: Users
users.name: Name
users.storesHint: OWNER and ADMIN can access every store.
users.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Hand it over in person; the user can change it.
users.deactivateConfirm: The account will be deactivated and all its sessions closed immediately.
users.resetPasswordConfirm: All of this user's sessions will be closed.
users.resetTwoFactorConfirm: The user will have to set up two-factor authentication again. Their sessions will be closed.

account.title: My account
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were closed.
account.logoutAllConfirm: You will be signed out of every device, including this one.

palette.placeholder: Go to… or run an action

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.generic: The operation failed. Try again in a moment.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to open this page.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Wrong email or password, or account temporarily locked.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.CONFLICT: This action conflicts with the current state.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.TOO_SHORT: The password must be at least 12 characters long.
errors.SAME_AS_EMAIL: The password must not be your email.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Unsupported format: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF only.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: Service temporarily unavailable (media storage not configured?).

system.title: System
system.processingHelp: Without a permanent worker (test environment), jobs are processed in rounds: an external scheduler starts one every 30 minutes, and you can start one here.
system.testEventDone: Test event #{{id}} published: it will be processed by the next round.

stores.title: Stores
stores.name: Store name
stores.orderPrefixHint: 2 to 4 letters, unique per store (e.g. BT → BT-000123). Applies to future orders.
stores.defaultLocaleMissing: The default language must be one of the offered languages.
stores.domainsHint: Read-only: custom domain setup arrives in phase 10.

media.title: Media library — {{name}}
media.uploadHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 4 MB per image. Metadata (GPS position, camera) is removed. AVIF/WebP versions are generated by job processing.
media.deleteConfirm: The image and all its versions will be permanently deleted.

products.title: Products — {{name}}
products.name: Internal name
products.nameHint: Only visible in the back office.
products.statusHint: “On sale” requires a title in every store language and an active variant with a non-zero price.
products.optionsHint: Colour, size… (up to 3). Without options, the product has a single variant. One variant is created per combination.
products.variantsHint: Compare-at price: optional, above the price. Cost: unit cost, used for profit. Carrier ref.: product at the carrier (outsourced stock).
products.noImage: No image: the first image is used on the product page and when shared.
products.stale: Someone changed this product in the meantime: reload the page to see their version.
products.slugTaken: This address (slug) is already used by another product.
products.skuTaken: SKUs already used by another product: {{skus}}.

issues.NO_OPTION_SINGLE_VARIANT: Without options, the product must have a single variant.
issues.COMPARE_AT_NOT_ABOVE_PRICE: Line {{line}}: the compare-at price must be above the price.
